Package render_engine.api

Interface ViewportPositionValidator

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    ViewportContainer
    public interface ViewportPositionValidator
    An interface to be implemented when an intersection between a sprite shape and viewport needs to be tested or, when a provided coordinate and image size needs to be converted to a position in the viewport

    • Method Detail

      • getViewportPosition

        java.awt.geom.Point2D getViewportPosition​(java.awt.Point offset,
                                          double x,
                                          double y,
                                          int size)
        Gets the x and y coordinates adjusted to the viewport
        Parameters:
        offset - the specified offset value used to adjust the x and y values
        x - the specified x value to adjust
        y - the specified y value to adjust
        size - the specified size of the image to fit within the viewport
        Returns:
        a new point adjusted to the viewport area (Orthogonal points)

      • intersects

        boolean intersects​(java.awt.Point offset,
                   double x,
                   double y,
                   int size)
        Determines whether the specifies whether the specified sprite shape intersects the viewport area
        Parameters:
        offset - the specified offset value used to adjust the x and y values
        x - the specified x value to test
        y - the specified y value to test
        size - the specified size of the image expected to intersect the viewport area
        Returns:
        True if the sprite shape intersects the viewport area. False otherwise
